episodes.synopsis: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.
episodes.title: What's This? My Heart Is Pounding

episodes.synopsis: Up in the clouds, My Melody has an ominous encounter with a giant, fluffy bear. Back in Mariland, Flat encourages her to join the upcoming sweets contest.
episodes.title: Fluffy and Soft

episodes.synopsis: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.
episodes.title: Kuromi's Great Recipe Heist

episodes.synopsis: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.
episodes.title: Honey Car Chase!

episodes.synopsis: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?
episodes.title: The Sweets Contest Begins

episodes.synopsis: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...
episodes.title: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki

episodes.synopsis: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.
episodes.title: What Should I Do?

episodes.synopsis: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.
episodes.title: Time for Teamwork

episodes.synopsis: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.
episodes.title: To the Cloud Kingdom!

episodes.synopsis: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.
episodes.title: Pistachio's Past

episodes.synopsis: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.
episodes.title: All for Our Best Friend

episodes.synopsis: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?
episodes.title: My Melody & Kuromi
